## Grants

Full amounts and roles are on the [Research](research.qmd#funded-projects) page.
In summary: two Australian Research Council projects held as Primary Chief
Investigator (PI equivalent) — a DECRA and a multi-institutional Discovery
Project — and a DARPA program held as Chief Investigator, first-named after the
lead.

## Service

**Program co-chair** — The Sixth International Conference on Quantitative
Ethnography (ICQE24); Poster & Demo Track, 16th International Learning Analytics
& Knowledge Conference (LAK26).

**Editorial boards** — *International Journal of Computer-Supported
Collaborative Learning* (2026–); *Journal of Quantitative Ethnography* (2026–).

**Program committee** — ICQE21 through ICQE26; LAK21 through LAK26; FLAIRS-33
Intelligent Learning Technologies.

**Reviewing** — *Artificial Intelligence Review*, *Australasian Journal of
Educational Technology*, *British Journal of Educational Technology*, *Computers
& Education*, *Computers and Education: Artificial Intelligence*, *Computers in
Human Behavior*, *Frontiers in Psychology*, *IEEE Transactions on Learning
Technologies*, *International Journal of Computer-Supported Collaborative
Learning*, *Journal of Learning Analytics*, *Journal of the Learning Sciences*,
Nova Science Publishers, and the ICLS, CSCL, LAK, ICQE and FLAIRS conferences.

**At Monash** — Education and Analytics Group Coordinator, Department of
Human-Centred Computing (2024–2025); Team Lead, AI Learning Circle (2023–2025);
Committee Member, Education Transformation Project, Faculty of Information
Technology (2022–2023).
